purpose: Reusable component and layout layer for real prototype assembly. Surface files are copied or referenced as concrete presets instead of being recreated from memory.
whenToUse: Use when the selected visual pack needs concrete reusable UI building blocks
Use when the prototype should prove which component presets and layouts were applied
Use when a skeleton needs a file-backed showcase across multiple visual variants
forbiddenPatterns: inventing component chrome that ignores the loaded token contract
claiming a component preset was used without linking its source file
description: Normalized UI components and blocks. Reference implementations from shadcn/ui + HyperUI + WeUI.

structure.primitives/: Atomic UI components: button, input, card, badge, tabs, avatar, checkbox, select
structure.cards/: Composite card components: stat, profile, metric, list-item, progress
structure.blocks/: Section-level blocks: dashboard-header, feed-item, onboarding, mobile-nav, dialog, stats-progress, sidebar

tokenContract: All components use --vb-* CSS custom properties from foundation/tokens.css
usage: Copy-paste into projects. Requires foundation/tokens.css and one theme file.
